events.description: A Night of Worship: The Songs of Robin Mark Join us for a special evening of worship as we celebrate the powerful music and ministry of Robin Mark, one of the most influential worship songwriters of our time. Best known for writing worship anthems such as "Days of Elijah," "Jesus, All for Jesus," "Revival," "The Wonder of the Cross," "When It's All Been Said and Done" and "Not by Might," Robin Mark's songs have inspired believers around the world to draw closer to God through heartfelt praise and worship. This uplifting night will feature many of Robin Mark's most loved songs, giving us the opportunity to sing together, reflect on God's faithfulness, and celebrate the hope we have in Christ. Whether these songs have been part of your worship journey for years or you are hearing them for the first time, this evening promises to be a meaningful time of praise, encouragement, and community. Come ready to lift your voice, worship with friends and family, and experience the joy of gathering around songs that have impacted churches across the globe. Together we'll revisit timeless favorites, share in God's presence, and proclaim His goodness through song. "These are the days of Elijah, declaring the Word of the Lord." All are welcome. Bring a friend and join us for an unforgettable evening of worship through the songs of Robin Mark. This special worship night is also a fundraiser in support of the 2027 Fun With Family Day Festival, whose theme is"Victory Over Darkness." Through worship, community, and outreach, the festival seeks to share the hope, light, and transforming love of Jesus Christ with individuals and families throughout our region. As we sing these powerful songs of faith, revival, and God's faithfulness, we are reminded that Christ has overcome the darkness of sin, fear, and despair. Every donation and act of support helps create opportunities to proclaim that message of hope beyond the walls of the church and into our community. Together, we can help create an event where families encounter encouragement, connection, and the life-changing truth that"the light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it." By supporting this fundraiser, you are investing in a ministry that seeks to point people to the ultimate victory found in Jesus Christ.

events.title: Another Night of Country Music

events.description: After packing the house with a sold-out performance in November 2025, The Sharpe Brothers Band is making a highly anticipated return to the Manitou Opera House this November - this time for two performances of Another Night of Country Music. And before anyone asks - no, they're not all brothers. The Sharpe Brothers Band features brothers Will Sharpe (vocals/guitar) and James Sharpe (vocals/bass), along with Charlie Howatt (steel guitar), Gil Dudgeon (drums), and Larry Martineau (fiddle/harmonica). A performance at the Manitou Opera House with The Sharpe Brothers Band offers a timeless country music experience reminiscent of the Grand Ole Opry, right here in southern Manitoba. Audiences can expect a show filled with traditional country music, honky-tonk favourites, outstanding musicianship, a few surprises, and the warm, intimate atmosphere that has made the historic Manitou Opera House one of southern Manitoba's premier live music venues. Their 2025 appearance at the Manitou Opera House sold out well in advance, leaving many hoping for another opportunity to experience the band live. In response to the demand, the Manitou Opera House Foundation is thrilled to welcome them back for not one, but two unforgettable showings of country music, offering audiences the opportunity to attend either - or both - shows. With last year's performance selling out, early ticket purchases are strongly encouraged. Thank you to our event sponsors: Manitou Thrift Store, Dead Horse Cider Co., and Blumstein Brewing Co. Cash bar selling beverages and snacks will be open at before the show and at intermission.

events.description: A Night of Worship: The Songs of Robin Mark Join us for a special evening of worship as we celebrate the powerful music and ministry of Robin Mark, one of the most influential worship songwriters of our time. Whether these songs have been part of your worship journey for years or you are hearing them for the first time, this evening promises to be a meaningful time of praise, encouragement, and community. Come ready to lift your voice, worship with friends and family, and experience the joy of gathering around songs that have impacted churches across the globe. Together we'll revisit timeless favorites, share in God's presence, and proclaim His goodness through song. "These are the days of Elijah, declaring the Word of the Lord." All are welcome. Bring a friend and join us for an unforgettable evening of worship through the songs of Robin Mark. This special worship night is also a fundraiser in support of the 2027 Fun With Family Day Festival, whose theme is"Victory Over Darkness." Through worship, community, and outreach, the festival seeks to share the hope, light, and transforming love of Jesus Christ with individuals and families throughout our region. As we sing these powerful songs of faith, revival, and God's faithfulness, we are reminded that Christ has overcome the darkness of sin, fear, and despair. Every donation and act of support helps create opportunities to proclaim that message of hope beyond the walls of the church and into our community. Together, we can help create an event where families encounter encouragement, connection, and the life-changing truth that"the light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it." By supporting this fundraiser, you are investing in a ministry that seeks to point people to the ultimate victory found in Jesus Christ.

Huston has packed his trunk, grown his beard & trundled off to towns & cities recreating the tours & performances of Victorian author, Charles Dickens to full houses & standing ovations. “powerful one-man theatre…in the hands of a master storyteller.” The National Post Now in its 35th season Huston performs A Christmas Carol narrating & playing all the characters from Scrooge to Tiny Tim using a remarkable range of accents, & body language. events.description: International violin sensation and five-time Gospel Music Award winner Rosemary Siemens has performed four times at New York's Carnegie Hall, made history as the first violinist to perform at the Sistine Chapel at the Vatican, and taken the stage at the Grand Ole Opry. With over 200 million YouTube views, Rosemary's Sunday Hymn Serenade - Bring Back the Hymns has become one of the world's leading hymn channels. Her career spans more than 25 countries and 40 U.S. states, including performances for two U.S. presidents and Canadian prime ministers. Together as SaxAndViolin, Rosemary and Eli will share the Christmas carols and beloved hymns you love, with Rosemary singing and playing violin, Eli on saxophone, and special family performances. Rosemary will also share inspiring stories from her international musical journey and the faith that has guided it. Bring your children, parents, grandparents, and friends. events.title: Mark Humphries Orchestra Christmas Show
events.time: 2:00 PM · Manitou Opera House, 325 Main Street, Manitou, MB
events.description: Swing into the holiday season at the Manitou Opera House! Get into the Christmas spirit with an afternoon of festive music, big band swing, Christmas favourites and plenty of laughs when the Mark Humphries Orchestra takes the stage at the historic Manitou Opera House. From classic big band sounds to the holiday songs you know and love, this special Christmas performance promises an afternoon filled with music, memories and Christmas cheer. Whether you're a longtime fan of big band music or looking for a fun and festive way to celebrate the season, the Mark Humphries Orchestra is sure to put a swing in your Christmas step! Sunday, December 13, 2026 2:00 PM Doors open at 1:30 PM Manitou Opera House — Manitou, Manitoba About the Mark Humphries Orchestra Originally from Yorkshire, England, Mark Humphries comes from a family where music and entertainment run deep. His father, Dick Van Winkle, toured the world as a multi-instrumental comedic entertainer. Mark's own musical journey began at the age of 13 when his trumpet teacher invited him to sit in with a local swing band called Sounds 40. That early experience eventually led to performances with the UK's premier big band, the Syd Lawrence Orchestra. The original Mark Humphries Orchestra was formed in 1987 and toured throughout the United Kingdom until Mark and his wife, Jill, emigrated with their family to Western Manitoba in 2008. After settling in Manitoba, Mark returned to performing with the Brandon-based Scotty McIntosh Big Band. Following McIntosh's retirement, Mark took over as leader and reinvented the ensemble, bringing together talented musicians from Brandon University, Winnipeg, Shilo, Melita, Swan River and Saskatchewan. Today, Humphries proudly carries on the family tradition of combining music and comedy, bringing audiences the Canadian version of the Mark Humphries Orchestra. A Christmas Afternoon of Music & Laughter For this special Christmas performance, audiences can expect the orchestra to put its own swinging spin on the holiday season. Come enjoy an afternoon of: Big band swing Christmas favourites Classic music Mark Humphries' signature comedy A festive afternoon at the historic Manitou Opera House Bring your family, friends or fellow music lovers and swing into the holiday season with us!
